Shanghai Municipal Council.
July 18th 1916
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE (DETECTIVE BRANCH)）

Sir,
A meeting attended by about 400 persons was held under
the auspices of the Koumintang party in Chang Cu Ho's
Garden at 5. p.m. 17th inst.
Speeches were made by Sun Yat Sen, Wong Tsung Ding 王正廷
Huang Hsing, Weng Yau Ban 黄炎培 Dr. Wu Ting Fang, explaining
the principles of republican government.
Tang Shao Yi, Wen Tsung Yao 温宗尧, Nyou Tih Sung 钮铁生
Pah Vung Wei 杨文蔚 Tsu Pao San 朱葆三 and Sung Pao Tsunr 宋保昌
City Magistrate were on the platform.
Zeo Koh Liang 徐国梁 Chief of the Chinese Police, Zau
Li Wong 赵进贤 Staff officer to General Yang, and S.K.Chen
of the Bureau of Foreign Affairs were among those present
at the meeting, which was very orderly and terminated
at 8.10 p.m.

One hundred and twenty soldiers returned from Pootung to
Loongwha on 17th inst.
The cruisers Tong Chi 通济 and Ying Zou 应瑞 left Woosung
for Fokien on 17th instant with a consignment of provisions
for the republican soldiers in Fokien.
General Yang has three times telegraphed to Chiangchun
Li Yish Chan; 李厚基 of Fokien requesting him to send
back 2,000 soldiers who were lent to his province from the
Arsenal Garrison but no answer has been received.

Your Obedient Servant,
（签名）
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（批：Ask!）

上海工部局。
1916年7月18日
（印：上海工部局警务处（侦探股））

先生：

本月17日下午5时，在张竹侯花园，由国民党主持举行了一次约有400人参加的集会。

孙中山、王正廷、黄兴、黄炎培、伍廷芳博士发表演说，阐释共和政府之原则。

唐绍仪、温宗尧、钮铁生、杨文蔚、朱葆三及市长宋保昌均在主席台上。

华捕总巡徐国梁、杨将军的参谋赵进贤以及外交局的S.K.陈（音译）等人出席了会议。会议秩序井然，于晚上8时10分结束。

本月17日，一百二十名士兵从浦东返回龙华。

“通济”号和“应瑞”号巡洋舰于本月17日离开吴淞前往福建，运送一批给福建共和军士兵的补给品。

杨将军已三次致电福建的李厚基，要求他将借自兵工厂驻军的2000名士兵遣返，但尚未收到回复。

您顺从的仆人，
（签名）
总探长。

警务处总监。

（批：询问！）
